summary: Implemented custom global generators loaded by name from the cache's extensions/generators folder. Changes: conans/client/cache/cache.py adds GENERATORS_EXTENSION_FOLDER and a generators_path property; conans/client/generators/__init__.py adds _load_custom_generator_class (loads <name>.py and returns the class of the same name, rejecting path-separator names), _get_generator_class checks built-ins first and then custom generators, and write_generators takes an optional generators_path; conans/client/installer.py passes self._cache.generators_path at both call sites. Nothing was run or tested, per instructions, and nothing was committed. No tests or docs were added.
